articles.title: As AI safety concerns mount, three pioneers make the case for staying open
articles.summary: At Ai4, three of the world's most respected AI experts — Geoffrey Hinton, Fei-Fei Li, and Andrew Ng — debated regulation, open source access, and how America can compete as China advances in Asia.
